items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Buddy Rich and myself in the same column, saying youngsters who you must watch in the future.

ctx.x: He's still going strong, still writing in New Orleans. He is? He's got things in several books out now. Of course he's an editor of that Jazzman, which I thought was a good book for its time.

Seeing Buddy Rich in town reminds me that I had a write-up in Metronome magazine, Buddy Rich and myself in the same column, saying youngsters who you must watch in the future. And they mentioned myself and Buddy Rich in the same column.
What year was that? Oh, about 38.
